plugins.name: sf-dev-kit
plugins.description: Opinionated, security-first AI workflow for Salesforce DX projects in Claude Code. Five-step quickstart; SessionStart nudge on fresh SFDX projects; detect-review-edit-verify bootstrap. Hardened security model: prod orgs hard-blocked, metadata-only SOQL, anonymous Apex refused, runtime-only consent. 11 subagents, 56 skills, 11 domain packs.
